question: What significant agricultural evidence was discovered at the Harappan site of Kalibangan?

options.text: Stone granaries used for seed storage

solution:
The correct answer is __**Criss-cross plough marks in fields**__.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 __ 
• The Harappan site of **Kalibangan**, located in present-day **Rajasthan, India**, revealed significant evidence of agriculture, including **criss-cross plough marks in fields**__. 
• These plough marks are believed to be the **earliest evidence of field ploughing** in the Indian subcontinent. They provide insights into the agricultural practices of the Harappan civilization.
